Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Testare și evaluare sisteme IT
At Perficient , we build software that powers enterprise-grade laboratory medical devices capable of continuously analyzing thousands of samples. We are looking for a QA Associate with 6 to 12 months of experience in both manual and automation testing of web and desktop applications to join our testing team and help ensure the reliability, performance, and quality of our solutions in this critical domain.
 If you are passionate about quality and want to contribute to software that truly makes an impact, this role could be a great fit for you.
 What You Will Do 
Plan, design, and execute manual test cases for web and desktop applications
Identify defects, document them clearly, and track their resolution
Validate new features and ensure existing functionalities remain stable
Work closely with developers, product owners, and other team members to clarify requirements and understand user workflows
Participate in test planning, estimation, and process improvements
Contribute to maintaining high-quality standards in a highly regulated industry
Communicate test progress, risks, and results in a clear and structured manner
 Your Skill Set 
 6–12 months of experience in Manual QA testing for web and/or desktop applications. This role is ideal for an Associate QA professional at the beginning of their career, looking to learn, grow, and gain hands-on experience in a supportive environment. We expect you to become increasingly independent and actively contribute within your first 2–3 months.
Good understanding of QA methodologies, test design techniques, and the software development lifecycle.
Experience working with test management and defect tracking tools.
Basic understanding of test automation concepts is important.
Previous experience in a regulated industry, such as medical devices or pharmaceuticals, would be highly valuable.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills and professional proficiency in English.
 Education: 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Bioinformatics, or a related field. A completed technical degree is important for this role, given the complexity of the products and the domain in which we operate.
 Location 
 This role is based in Cluj-Napoca . We do offer a hybrid work model , combining the flexibility of remote work with the benefits of in-person collaboration, however for this position, the work will take place mostly from the office.
